user_story: As a guest, I want cancelling an already-cancelled booking to return a clear error so that duplicate cancellations are handled.

positive.title: Successfully cancel a booking that has not been cancelled yet
steps: Navigate to the booking summary page.
Locate the booking that is confirmed but not yet cancelled.
Confirm cancellation in the pop-up modal.
positive.expected_result: The booking status is updated to 'Cancelled' and a confirmation message is displayed.

negative.title: Attempt to cancel an already-cancelled booking
steps: Navigate to the booking summary page.
Locate the booking that has already been cancelled.
Attempt to confirm cancellation in the pop-up modal.
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating the booking has already been cancelled, and no further action is taken.

edge.title: Attempt to cancel a booking with an invalid or corrupted booking ID
steps: Navigate to the booking management page.
Manually enter an invalid or corrupted booking ID in the URL.
Attempt to cancel the booking using the 'Cancel Booking' button.
edge.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating the booking ID is invalid and the booking cannot be found or cancelled.
